entries.title: Agent starts again with the current ACEX client
entries.description: The agent crashed on start-up because it still used the old ACEX client interface. It now uses the updated client, so it starts and syncs normally. No settings changed; `ACEX_API_URL` is still the base URL of the ACEX API.

entries.title: Dashboards removed from ACEX are deleted from the ACEX folder (on by default)
entries.description: With `PRUNE_DASHBOARDS` (default `true`), every dashboard in the target folder that ACEX no longer lists is deleted, including dashboards someone added there by hand. Dashboards outside the folder are never touched. Set `PRUNE_DASHBOARDS=false` to keep them.

entries.title: New agent keeps a Grafana instance in sync with ACEX
entries.description: `acex-grafana-sync` fetches the datasource and dashboard definitions that ACEX generates and pushes them to Grafana in a folder (default uid `acex`, title `ACEX`), which it creates if missing. It checks ACEX every poll cycle and only writes to Grafana when the definitions have changed or the previous attempt failed. Also available as a container image.

entries.title: Settings for the Grafana sync agent
entries.description: Required: `ACEX_API_URL`, `GRAFANA_URL`, and either `GRAFANA_TOKEN` or `GRAFANA_USER` with `GRAFANA_PASSWORD` (not both). Optional: `GRAFANA_FOLDER_UID`, `GRAFANA_FOLDER_TITLE`, `POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS` (default 60), `PRUNE_DASHBOARDS`, `ACEX_VERIFY_SSL` and `GRAFANA_VERIFY_SSL` for TLS verification of each endpoint. The agent exits at start-up if required settings are missing; if Grafana or ACEX is unreachable it logs the error and retries on the next cycle.

entries.title: What the agent creates, overwrites and leaves alone in Grafana
entries.description: Datasources are created only if missing and never overwritten, so manual edits such as rotated credentials stay. Dashboards are overwritten on every change in ACEX, and a dashboard that already lives in a different folder is skipped with a warning. Edits made by hand to an ACEX dashboard are replaced the next time ACEX changes it.
